run_vending_machine_demo: run the python module to simulate a vending machine with items, money, and purchases
create_Item: create an Item with code, label, value, count, group, and expiration date
use_Sys_store_put: use Sys store put to place an Item at a specific slot position
list_items_with_ls: list all items in the vending machine using the Sys ls method
buy_item_with_add_money: add money with add_money then buy an item at a slot position
